item.title: Hubble 2.4.0-beta.1
item.description:
# Hubble 2.4.0 beta 1
- **Modules in their own windows.** Right-click a module in the sidebar and choose **Open in its own window ›** for the whole module or one of its parts, such as Cyanview's Camera Configuration. Each window shows only that module, is titled with the module's name and the part it shows, such as "Hubble - Cyanview - Camera Configuration", and opens again where it was at the next start. The module stays usable in the main window too. - **Name your modules.** Rename a module from the sidebar or from Module Connections, and the same name shows in the sidebar, its windows, the menus and the Status Log. - **Pop-overs on Stream Deck (Beta).** Group buttons into a pop-over from the Button Matrix's right-click menu. A main key with a folded corner opens its sub buttons over the page while the other keys dim; pressing it again or changing page closes it. Pop-overs can be duplicated, ungrouped and arranged on the Button layout page. - **One search field.** ⌘F opens one field in the Button Matrix: **Find** marks matches, **Rows** shows only the rows that match, and **Columns** shows only the columns that match. A match inside a folded pop-over opens it while the search shows it. Module grids get the same field when their module uses it. Searching never changes what is saved. - **Turn a whole action column off.** A switch in an action column's header, or its right-click menu, stops that column's actions and its feedback on every key, and dims its cells. A collapsed column too narrow for the switch shows its name instead. - **Undo in module grids.** A module grid that asks for it gets Undo and Redo from Hubble, with ⌘Z, ⇧⌘Z and the Edit menu. Each paste, fill, clear, cut and choice is one step, and an Undo leaves alone a cell that has changed since. - **Button layout and Stream Deck:** - Two-finger drag pans the key grid, and a pinch zooms it. - Page up, Page down, Home and go-to-page work on any key or dial. - Highlight on device lights every selected button's key, not only one. - An autofill drag replaces the Hubble buttons already on square keys and leaves encoders alone. - Saving a Companion page takes about 0.13 s instead of 1.7 s, and the key grid no longer empties and rebuilds while a page reloads. - **Faster module grids.** Selecting and editing cells on a large module grid redraws in less time. On Camera Control, an Enter reaches the screen in about 40 ms instead of about 60 ms. - **Fixes:** - A very long failure message, or a refused live result in one row, no longer stops the core runtime. - Moving rows that split a formula's range keeps the range's pieces instead of showing `#REF!`. - A right-click menu opened right after another one closes keeps its focus. - A DIT Browse workspace action reports the workspace that is showing. - A retired module removed from an imported file no longer leaves its name behind. - An unchanged button is no longer marked Edited. - **Module versions.** Module parts in windows, the search field and undo in a module's own page come with each module's next version, which needs this Hubble.
This beta upgrades the saved workspace. Earlier versions of Hubble can't open it afterwards.
This is a beta. It reaches Macs that have turned on **Get beta updates** in Hubble's **Check for Updates…** window.

item.title: Hubble 2.3.0
item.description:
# Hubble 2.3.0
- **Key colours come on sooner on the Stream Deck.** A key's new colour no longer waits behind every other Hubble key in Companion, or behind a router's own status messages inside Hubble. With simulated equipment, a router key's colour arrived about 35 ms sooner, and keys that change together no longer queue behind one another. - **Keys look the way they do on the deck.** The Live Key, the header key, the colour picker, **Show Key Look** and Hubble's own Stream Deck faces now fill the whole key with its Background Color and draw the text in its own colour, as Companion does. Every key has the same soft shading wherever it's drawn, and a **Gradient** switch in the key colour popup turns it off for a key that should be one flat colour. - **Wide key faces on a Stream Deck Studio.** On Companion 5, Hubble draws each key face in the shape of the device chosen for its page in **Button layout**, so a Studio's wider keys are filled from edge to edge and other decks stay sharp. Button layout shows a Studio page with wide keys too. - **Works with Companion 5.1.** Removing, moving and copying buttons in **Button layout** work on Companion 5.1, and keys Hubble places there can be edited. The disc that fills while a long-press key is held is set up on Companion 5, editing a long-press key's Button ID saves, and connection setup works on early Companion 5.0 builds. - **A darker look with clearer layers.** The sheet is the blackest part of the window, with the sidebar and the bars each a step above it. Status sits in fixed pills, buttons keep their label and width while they work, dropdown lists share one set of rules, hover hints are Hubble's own, and wording is the same everywhere, such as **Remove module** and **Save changes**. - **The Button layout editor shows what the Button Matrix shows.** Selecting a button lists only the cells filled in on that button's row, named by their Button Matrix columns. **Feedbacks** lists a module's triggers, and the editor's colours open the Button Matrix colour popup with **Outline color** and **Bar color**. - **Easier formulas.** F4 or ⌃L locks the reference at the caret, stepping through `$A$1`, `A$1`, `$A1` and `A1`, and **Off**, **Row**, **Column** and **Both** buttons beside the Cell source bar do the same with a click. ⌃E edits the selected cell in place, like F2. `=` on a module choice cell gives the name it shows, and typing in a choice cell keeps what you typed. - **CCC is gone from your workspaces.** CCC was retired in 2.1.0 and its saved data stayed behind. The first time this version opens your configuration it removes that data from every workspace: CCC's **Retired** columns with the values in them, CCC actions and feedbacks on Advanced buttons, the saved camera list, and CCC's entry among your modules. Everything else stays as it was, and nothing changes in what your buttons do. Older files still import, without their CCC columns. - **Modules.** A module can show a wide logo beside its name in the sidebar, and a module running a beta version is marked **Beta**. Updating a module yourself clears its waiting automatic update. An open module page no longer keeps Hubble busy: HubDash now receives only what changed, and changes still show as soon as they did. - **Fixes.** Formulas keep pointing at the same cells when a module's action column is deleted, added or moved. A formula typed after F2 in a text cell saves as a formula. A slider in a sheet cell keeps its length while you drag. Updating the Hubble module in Companion no longer stops keys with long presses from syncing. - **For module authors.** Module pages can take Hubble's look by name (`module-theme-v1`). A module can ask for values in a HubDash dialog from a key press and refresh it while it is open (`module-prompt-v1`, `module-prompt-update-v1`). Feedback triggers can be grouped (`module-feedback-trigger-groups-v1`), and a matrix can declare up to 64 triggers (`module-feedback-triggers-64-v1`).
This release includes version **0.3.8** of the Hubble module for Companion. To get the wide Studio faces and the faster key colours, choose **Install / Reinstall** in **Module Connections** or **Button layout**, or **Update in Companion** in Hubble → **Service Settings…**.
**This update changes your configuration in a way older versions can't open,** including 2.2.2. It removes CCC's saved data and adds the per-key Gradient setting. Export your configuration first if you might go back. Files exported from older versions still import.
